agent_vs_you: The agent treated the URL as words laid over the clip and built the end card itself, from a flux-2-klein "completely uniform solid black frame" plus a code overlay. Both halves broke. Flux read "black frame" as a picture frame and drew a white panel inside a black border. The overlay sized the 31-character URL at 1/12 of 720 px (60 px), which is wider than the frame, and a URL has no spaces, so the 80% word-wrap could not break it and both ends were cut off. The plan has no size param, so "fit within frame with safe margins" did nothing. assemble also ignored "coffee 5 s, card 3 s" and split 8 s equally (the cut is at 4.02 s), so the card sat blank from 4 to 5 s. The catalogue's own CHOOSING rule routes "a title or end card" to one image node with lettering: true. qwen draws the plain black card and the exact URL together, and code reads the URL back and fixes a misspelling once. That is the tool I would use, followed by assemble with seconds 0, so the 5 s pour keeps its length and the card gets 2.5 s.

your_plan.say: I'll make a 5-second close-up of coffee pouring into a ceramic cup, then a plain black end card with your URL in white, centred on one line, and join them into one silent vertical clip.

params.prompt_or_change: Close-up of hot coffee pouring in a steady stream into a plain white ceramic cup on a wooden table, warm morning light, shallow depth of field, locked camera; no text, logos or labels anywhere.

steps.why: A free scene with nothing to start from. The model's invented sound is dropped by code.

params.prompt_or_change: A plain solid pure-black background, completely empty, with one line of clean white sans-serif text centred exactly in the middle: "https://example.com/Go?ref=June". Keep the capital G and J and every punctuation mark exactly; the line spans about two thirds of the width; no other text, no border, no objects, no texture.

steps.why: An end card is a designed piece. qwen letters the exact URL on a true black ground, and code reads it back and fixes a misspelling once. This avoids both the AI 'black frame' and an overlay that cannot fit a 31-character unbreakable line.

params.prompt_or_change: The pour first, then the end card, hard cut, silent.

steps.why: seconds 0 keeps the pour at its own 5 s and gives the card 2.5 s (7.7 s in all). seconds 8 would make code split it 4/4 and cut the pour short.

fix: (1) text-overlay: shrink the font until the longest unbreakable line fits 90% of the frame width, and accept "size:" in extra (the catalogue already says "unless the size is set", but the plan cannot set it). (2) assemble: honour per-piece durations given in extra ("coffee_pour.mp4: 5 s; card: 3 s") instead of an equal split. (3) Add a catalogue line: "plain colour card with exact words (end card, URL card) → image with lettering: true". (4) Grader: never report "speech heard" on a track whose peak is below -60 dB.
evidence: black_end_card.png (360x640) is a white rectangle inside a black border: flux read 'frame' literally. In the grader frame at 7 s there is a white panel, a grey 55% band, and the URL cut at both edges ('ps://example.com/Go?ref=J'). Scene detection on silent_sequence.mp4 puts the cut at 4.02 s, not 5 s. coffee_final.mp4's audio peaks at -91 dB (silent), yet the judge was told speech was heard. The two major faults are real.
